$comment: Byte ceilings on the brain.md and experiment.md bodies (frontmatter excluded), checked by scripts/smoke_agent_defs.mts §C55 against its pinned pre-ratchet BASELINE. A ceiling rises only with a growth entry naming the metric the new text moves, the script that measures it, the item or commit it came from, and the text it superseded (deleted in the same diff) or 'none'. Deletions are logged with negative bytes.
